WITH measured AS (
    SELECT ID, COUNT(*) AS measurements,
           SUM(typeof(IGG) NOT IN ('integer', 'real')) AS nonnumeric,
           SUM("Date" IS NOT date("Date")) AS non_iso_dates
    FROM main.Laboratory
    WHERE IGG IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ID
)
SELECT p.Admission, COUNT(*) AS patients, COUNT(m.ID) AS measured_patients,
       SUM(m.nonnumeric) AS nonnumeric, SUM(m.non_iso_dates) AS non_iso_dates
FROM main.Patient AS p
LEFT JOIN measured AS m ON m.ID = p.ID
GROUP BY p.Admission

WITH ranked_igg AS (
    SELECT ID, IGG,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ID ORDER BY "Date" DESC) AS recency
    FROM main.Laboratory
    WHERE IGG IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    CASE p.Admission
        WHEN '+' THEN 'admitted to the hospital'
        WHEN '-' THEN 'followed at the outpatient clinic'
    END AS care_setting,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN r.IGG > 900 AND r.IGG < 2000 THEN 1 END)
        / COUNT(*),
        1
    ) AS normal_igg_percentage
FROM main.Patient AS p
LEFT JOIN ranked_igg AS r ON r.ID = p.ID AND r.recency = 1
WHERE p.Admission IN ('+', '-')
GROUP BY p.Admission
ORDER BY p.Admission
LIMIT 2
